info.title: Lurus API V2 - Multi-Tenant Gateway
info.description:
Lurus API V2 provides multi-tenant access to LLM API gateway services.

## Authentication

V2 authenticates through OpenID Connect. Which provider, which issuer and
which client id are deploy-time configuration, not part of this contract:
the console redirects to whatever provider the deployment was given.

1. Redirect the user to `GET /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/auth/login`
2. The user authenticates with the deployment's configured OIDC provider
3. The provider calls back to `GET /api/v2/oauth/callback`
4. Later requests carry the session cookie, or a bearer token for the
   machine callers that hold one (`OIDCBearer` below)

## Tenant Isolation

All tenant-specific endpoints are scoped by `{tenant_slug}` in the URL path.
Users can only access data within their assigned tenant.

## Rate Limiting

- Every route below `/api/v2` sits behind one shared bucket: 600 requests
  per 180 s per source IP (`middleware.GlobalV2RateLimit`,
  api-v2-router.go). It is keyed by the client address, NOT by account or
  session, so everybody behind one NAT or CGNAT egress address spends the
  same budget - an office on a single public address shares one bucket.
- Those numbers are the shipped defaults. An operator retunes them with
  `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT` and `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT_DURATION`, so the limit
  a given deployment enforces may differ.
- A limit of 0 DISABLES the bucket; it does not mean unlimited. To turn the
  limiter off deliberately, set `GLOBAL_V2_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLE=false`.
- A reject is `429` with `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`,
  `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Scope: ip`,
  `X-RateLimit-Type: requests`, and an empty body.
- Individual routes may add a narrower bucket of their own on top of this
  one - see the 429 on `POST /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/redeem`.
- Relay traffic is metered by quota, not by this bucket.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Invoice and top-up history. Read-only: this spec documents no route that moves money.

get.description:
Redirects to the configured OIDC provider's login page. A PKCE challenge is sent only when OIDC_ENABLE_PKCE=true, which is off by default.
After successful authentication, user is redirected to callback URL.

parameters.name: redirect_url
parameters.description: URL to redirect after successful login

302.description: Redirect to the OIDC provider's login page

Location.description: Authorization URL at the configured OIDC provider

get.description:
Handles the OAuth callback from the configured OIDC provider.
Exchanges authorization code for tokens and creates session.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code issued by the OIDC provider

302.description: Redirect to original URL with session established

get.description: Returns current user session data for frontend

post.description: Logs out at the OIDC provider and clears the session

302.description: Redirect to the OIDC provider's logout URL

get.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile
Lists all available LLM provider channels

post.description: Creates a new LLM provider channel (Admin only)

get.description: Gets a specific channel by ID

Paginated model catalogue with a whitelist projection. This is NOT the
OpenAI /v1/models envelope - that one belongs to the relay surface and is
documented in relay.json.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Substring match on the model name

400.description: Missing tenant slug or invalid pagination

get.description:
p50/p95 latency and error rate per model over the last `hours`, for
the caller's tenant only (cached per pod for 5 minutes). Every member
gets the quality fields; tenant admins also get the volume fields
(requests, errors, total_tokens, quota, latency_samples).
`enough_samples` is false below `min_samples` latency samples — the
percentiles are then noise, not a measurement.
Lists all API tokens for the current user

201.description: Token created (includes full key, only shown once)

get.description: Lists the caller's own saved chat sessions, most-recently-updated first.

post.description: Saves a conversation the client already holds — the request carries the full turn array, not a single new turn to append.

400.description: Bad request — error_code is CHAT_SESSION_LIMIT_REACHED (the caller already owns 200 sessions in this tenant) or INVALID_REQUEST (oversized/invalid title, model, or messages).

get.description: Fetches one saved chat session (plus its messages) the caller owns.

patch.description: Partially updates title and/or model, and/or REPLACES the full message list, of a chat session the caller owns.

400.description: Bad request — error_code is INVALID_REQUEST (oversized/invalid title, model, or messages). A rejected update leaves the stored session unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes a chat session (and its messages) the caller owns.

get.description:
Monthly spend buckets for the calling user inside this tenant. Both query
parameters are optional; the range is always clamped to at most 12 calendar
months. There is deliberately no amount_usd field - no FX source is wired
into this endpoint.

mtd_quota.description: Billable quota in the current UTC calendar month

get.description: Gets usage logs for the current user

post.description:
Redeems a redemption code and credits the quota to the calling user.
Mounted at /api/v2/{tenant_slug}/redeem (api-v2-router.go), NOT under the
/redemptions collection. Guarded by a 5-requests-per-60-seconds per-IP
limiter because the code itself is the only credential.

schema.description: Send the 32-character code as either key or code; key wins when both are present.

400.description: Missing or malformed code, or the code is unusable (expired, already used, unknown). Body carries success=false, message and error_code.

429.description: Redemption rate limit exceeded. middleware.RedemptionRateLimit (rate-limit.go) allows 5 attempts per 60 s per client IP in the RD bucket, because the code itself is the only credential and an unthrottled run is code guessing. The reject carries the headers below and an EMPTY body - the limiter writes a bare status, not a JSON envelope, so a client must branch on the status code, not on `success`. If Redis is unreachable this bucket degrades to a process-local limiter rather than failing open, which makes the effective ceiling (replicas x 5) per 60 s until Redis returns. The wider /api/v2 bucket described in info.description applies first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this IP's redemption window frees a slot.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Attempts allowed per window. 5 for this bucket.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Attempts left in the window. Always 0 on a reject.

X-RateLimit-Scope.description: What the bucket is keyed by. Always `ip` here.

X-RateLimit-Type.description: What is being counted. Always `requests` here.

post.description: Creates a new redemption code (Admin only)
Creates a new tenant (Platform Admin only)

get.description: Gets a tenant by ID (Platform Admin only)

OIDCBearer.description: Bearer token issued by the deployment's configured OIDC provider. Which provider that is, is deploy-time configuration; no specific vendor is part of this contract.

TenantSlug.name: tenant_slug
TenantSlug.description: Tenant identifier (slug). On routes behind TenantSlugGuard the reserved value `~` means "the tenant this session authenticated into"; the server resolves it from the session, and it is what the console sends. An explicit slug must equal that tenant (403 TENANT_MISMATCH otherwise). `GET /user/me` reports the real slug as `tenant_slug`.

ChannelConfigInvalid.description: Invalid request body. Includes a channel config document (param_override, header_override, model_mapping, or setting) that failed save-time validation, in which case the body carries a code identifying which field.

ChannelConfigValidationError.description: 400 body for POST/PUT channel. code is present only when the request body's param_override (structural pre-pass + dry-run of the relay override engine), header_override, model_mapping, or setting document (shape validators) failed save-time validation; it is absent for other 400s on this endpoint (missing required field, malformed request JSON, etc).

InvoiceMonth.description: One calendar month of billable spend.

amount_cny.description: Amount charged for the month in CNY: the wallet charge recorded at settlement for each request that has one (logs.charged_cny4), plus the quota of the remaining billable rows priced at the current exchange rate (QuotaPerUnit / USDExchangeRate quota per CNY). Changing the exchange rate no longer re-prices recorded charges.

unbilled_quota.description: Quota logged but excluded from billing (settlement-failed or channel-test rows)

unbilled_request_count.description: Number of log rows excluded from billing

ModelCatalogEntry.description: Whitelist projection of a catalogue model row.

vendor.description: Vendor display name, empty when unknown
